data.title: bn-3kz: Make build-cart skill comprehensive
data.description: Progressive-disclosure rewrite of skills/build-cart: concise router; complete platform/cart, Lua API, CLI/RPC, sprite, map/metatile, music/SFX, and testing/packaging references; generated UI metadata; source-backed coverage validator.

data.body: The command reference is not yet complete for supported CLI flags. `console-agent playtest` accepts `--json` as an alias for `--format json` (crates/console-agent/src/playtest.rs:302), but this syntax/options list omits it. The same exact-syntax section only shows `-o` for sprite/map/music outputs even though all corresponding parsers also accept `--out`; please document those aliases where applicable (and, for full discoverability, the common `-h`/`--help` behavior). This matters because the requested contract is all console commands and flags, not only the flags printed by top-level help.

The validator passes despite the missing supported `--json` console-agent flag because it checks command names/leaves but no console-agent flags. Please extend the source-backed coverage gate to include the supported agent flag inventory (with an intentional way to exclude test-only sentinels such as `--bogus`) so future parser flags cannot silently disappear from the comprehensive reference. The current pack-only flag loop does not cover this requirement.

data.reason: Command flag coverage is incomplete: `playtest --json` and applicable output/help aliases are not fully documented, and the new validator does not check console-agent flags.

data.body: Fixed: documented playtest --json, the -o/--out aliases on every applicable renderer, and common -h/--help behavior. Coverage, quick validation, and just check pass.

Fixed: validator now extracts all long console-agent flag string literals from source, requires all 53 supported flags in the docs, checks -h/-o aliases, and keeps an explicit reasoned exclusion for the --bogus negative-test sentinel. Stale exclusions fail the gate. Coverage, quick validation, and just check pass.

The extraction and stale-exclusion logic are good, but the membership check still has a concrete prefix false-positive: `if flag not in docs` treats `--frames` as documentation for `--frame`, and `--output` as documentation for `--out`. I ran an in-memory negative test that removed every exact `--frame` token from the Markdown while leaving `--frames`; the validator still returned 0 (same for exact `--out`). Please use token-boundary matching for long flags, e.g. ensure the character after the flag is not `[a-z0-9-]` and the preceding character is not part of a flag token, then add a regression/negative self-check if practical. Exact removal of `--json` correctly returned 1.

data.reason: One validator issue remains: substring matching lets prefix-related flags such as --frame/--frames and --out/--output falsely satisfy coverage.

data.body: Fixed the substring blind spot: all console-agent and console-pack flags now use exact token-boundary matching, including short aliases. Added direct regressions proving --frames does not satisfy --frame, --output does not satisfy --out, and --out does not satisfy -o. Coverage, quick validation, git diff check, and full just check pass.

data.reason: Approved after exact-token coverage fix. Verified all 42 Lua globals, 53 console-agent flags, 28 RPC methods, all command leaves/references; exact removals of --json, --frame, and --out each fail coverage; quick_validate, git diff check, and full just check pass.
